name: Branch Spark
description: Throw a spark that splits once in flight and strikes two points on the same target.

name: Arc Parry
description: Meet a strike with a short arc along the forearm and turn it wide of the body.

name: Fork Stance
description: Stand with arms forked outward, a shell of charge on each, so blows from two sides meet a guard.

name: Fine Arc
description: Thread a fine arc from the fingertips into the soft joint of a target's guard.

name: Arc Scent
description: Let every prong of a small fork scent the charge of nearby bodies and metal.

name: Branching Bolt
description: Loose a bolt that branches into five thin arms and reaches targets spread across a narrow front.

name: Fork Step
description: Split the body's charge in two and step along one fork of it, landing beside the foe.

name: Arc Snare
description: Weave several arcs round a target's limbs into a crackling net that holds the body in place.

name: Triple Fork
description: Drive a three-pronged bolt through armour and guard so that all three prongs meet inside the target's body.

name: Antler Arc
description: Throw up both arms and let a spread of branching arcs sweep across every foe in front of the user.

name: Knuckle Bolt
description: Set the knuckles with dense charge and punch through a wooden board or a leather guard.

name: Fist Ward
description: Close the fist round a ball of static and ram it into a blow, shaking it apart.

name: Weight Charge
description: Settle the body's weight and charge into the leading shoulder before a heavy punch.

name: Hammer Step
description: Stamp forward with the full weight so that the earth answers with a pulse that pushes the user on.

name: Charge Hammer
description: Bring a charged fist down like a hammer on a guard and force the arms apart.

name: Anvil Hum
description: Plant and set the arms so that charge makes the body as unmoving as an anvil under blows.

name: Fist Peal
description: Smash a fist into the ground and send a booming peal outward that rocks nearby foes.

name: Thunder Hammer
description: Heave a fist wrapped in all the stored shock of the user onto a single point and break stone, bone or plate.

name: Shatter Fist
description: Punch a thin spike of charge through the wreck of a guard and out of the far side of a thick shield.

name: Charge Tingle
description: Spread the charge a pace outward from the skin and feel what passes through it.

name: Humming Skin
description: Thicken the field about the body into a hum that blunts cuts and thrown missiles.

name: Charge Mantle
description: Gather the field into a mantle on the shoulders so that each limb moves quick and strong.

name: Rebound Leap
description: Push off the edge of the field as if it were a wall and rebound several paces.

name: Spark Pinch
description: Pinch a spark out of the field's edge and flick it at the nearest target.

name: Charge Rap
description: Rap a fist of field-charge against the target's body from a pace beyond arm's length.

name: Bright Ring
description: Push the field outward in one bright ring that stings every body it crosses.

name: Charge Clamp
description: Close the field about a single target and hold it, charge clamping the joints.

name: Charged Drift
description: Ride the field's slow current sideways across a battlefield without a footfall.

name: Total Discharge
description: Let the whole field discharge at once, shocking every body within a wide reach around the user.

name: Static Lattice
description: Cast a lattice of still charge across a patch of ground that shocks anyone who crosses it.

name: Ozone Cloak
description: Draw a close layer of charged air about the body that dulls an arrow's flight.

name: Ozone Scent
description: Follow the faint ozone left by another cultivator's charge to the spot where it was last used.

name: Haze Spark
description: Loose a spark through the charged haze so that it seems to come from every side.

name: Smear Step
description: Step through the haze so the user's outline smears and the foe misjudges the distance.

name: Haze Turn
description: Bend the haze across an incoming strike so the blow slides past on the charged air.

name: Haze Blind
description: Flare the haze white at a foe's eyes so that sight, and then balance, is lost for several beats.

name: Haze Burst
description: Ignite the whole veil in one crackling burst that shocks and stuns all foes in close contact.

name: Static Mantle
description: Raise a heavy veil of static that stops thrown weapons and numbs any hand that strikes through it.

name: Twin Bolt
description: Cast one bolt from each hand in step and let them meet at a single mark.

name: Pair Hum
description: Hold a shell of charge before each arm in pair, so that a blow meets one while the other stays free.

name: Mirror Spark
description: Throw a spark and its mirror on opposite sides so the target cannot dodge both.

name: Matched Step
description: Take two steps on two pulses, left then right, so the body moves in an even beat.

name: Twin Read
description: Read the room with a spark in each hand and compare what each returns.

name: Pair Jab
description: Jab left and right in one beat with a pulse of charge behind each fist.

name: Echo Bolt
description: Loose a bolt and follow it a breath later with a second that rides the first one's path.

name: Twin Lash
description: Lash with both hands in one beat so the charge falls across the guard on either side.

name: Paired Parry
description: Parry with both forearms together, each laying a crackle on the blow to turn it away.

name: Twin Net
description: Wind two arcs, one from each hand, about a target's arms and legs and draw them together.

name: Double Crash
description: Send two bolts into the same point at the same instant and drive through plate and bone.

name: Matched Peal
description: Clap the hands together on two matched peals that meet in a booming wave over a wide span.

name: Cry Spark
description: Cry out as a spark leaves the hand, the shrill sound startling the target before the spark lands.

name: Cry Guard
description: Hold a high steady cry as a shell of charge grows round the chest.

name: Raptor Step
description: Spread both arms like pinions and leap a long pace on a pulse of charge from the soles.

name: Stoop Jab
description: Drop from a short rise and jab downward with a charged hand into the target's shoulder.

name: Cry Read
description: Cry once and read from the return of charge where the nearby bodies stand.

name: Shrill Peal
description: Raise a shrill peal that rings across the ground and stings the ears and nerves of those within it.

name: Talon Arc
description: Hook the fingers into a claw and rake a bright arc across a target's guard.

name: Dive Step
description: Fall from a height on a thread of charge and land lightly beside the foe.

name: Raptor Stoop
description: Dive upon a foe from above on a screaming bolt of charge and drive through the guard in one stroke.

name: Shrieking Peal
description: Loose a piercing peal that breaks the focus of every foe in range and shocks their ears.

name: Thread Spark
description: Let a spark run off the fingertips like a thread of water toward the target.

name: Conduit Guard
description: Run charge round the body in a smooth channel that carries blows aside.

name: Current Step
description: Step with the field's flow and let it carry the user on for several paces.

name: Stream Read
description: Read the flow of nearby charge to find where a rival's field bends and narrows.

name: Stream Lash
description: Whip a long running stream of charge from the hand across a foe's body.

name: Eddy Ward
description: Spin the field into an eddy before the chest that catches a blow and flings it aside.

name: Current Surge
description: Swell the river of charge through the fist at the moment of contact for a burst of shock.

name: Flowing Bolt
description: Hold a bolt open from the hand as a living flow that bends round guards and follows the target.

name: Surge Crash
description: Let the whole river of charge break over the ground ahead in one heavy surge that sweeps feet from under foes.

name: Oath Spark
description: Swear a spark to a mark, hold it a breath, then loose it unerringly.

name: Oathbound Hum
description: Swear a shell of charge to the body and keep it fixed, whatever force strikes it.

name: Peal Lunge
description: Step forward on a clap of thunder from the heel that closes the gap.

name: Bearing Read
description: Take the bearing of a distant discharge by the turn of the charge in the air.

name: Oath Knuckle
description: Jab straight along a sworn line with a hard charge in the knuckles.

name: Sworn Snap
description: Snap the fingers and break the rhythm of a foe's channeled charge.

name: Oathsworn Peal
description: Loose a sworn peal that rolls out in a fan and strikes all in the line of its bearing.

name: Held Footing
description: Keep the guard on one bearing against any push, so the body is neither turned nor driven back.

name: Oath Bolt
description: Loose a bolt along the sworn line with such weight that it is hard to turn aside.

name: Sworn Thunder
description: Bring down thunder on a sworn mark so that the shock covers a wide ground and holds all in it.

name: Oath Fork
description: Send a forked oath-bolt through a guard, one prong to hold it open and one to enter.

name: Straight Bolt
description: Cast a spark along a drawn line so that it flies straight and does not bend.

name: Bolt Screen
description: Hold a line of charge before the body that a blow cannot cross without breaking.

name: Streaking Stride
description: Cover a great step with one pulse and plant the heel exactly where intended.

name: Charge Trace
description: Trace a line of charge to a distant mark and feel what stands along it.

name: Arm Snap
description: Snap the closed hand along the line of the arm and let a charge leap after it.

name: Steady Bolt
description: Loose a bolt held steady on its bearing through wind and the target's own sway.

name: Plumb Turn
description: Turn the whole body on one bearing so that blows slide past and the next cast is already aimed.

name: Cast Breaker
description: Strike a foe's drawn line of charge at its middle and scatter the cast before it lands.

name: Unbent Bolt
description: Loose a bolt that does not bend, falter or slow, and strikes the exact mark at great range.

name: Remote Thread
description: Hold a single thread of charge on a distant target and pour it through the guard until it gives.

name: Bare Spark
description: Throw a spark with no ward kept up, the whole intent put behind the throw.

name: Loose Guard
description: Let the arms hang loose and turn blows with a sudden snap of charge rather than a set guard.

name: Free Step
description: Step wherever the charge points, unbound to any stance, in an unbroken run.

name: Wide Read
description: Open the senses wide in every direction and read the charge of all that moves near.

name: Naked Fist
description: Strike with a bare fist loaded with undirected charge that lashes the target's whole arm.

name: Wide Peal
description: Loose a peal in every direction at once, leaving the user's own front and back uncovered.

name: Loose Arc
description: Let arcs fly off the arms in no fixed order, each one finding its own mark.

name: Free Surge
description: Surge charge through every limb at once, leaving the user quick and near to overflowing.

name: Boundless Peal
description: Loose a peal with no limit put on it so that it rolls far beyond the user's reach.

name: Free Bolt
description: Fire a bolt from the open body without aim or ward, and its weight shakes a guard apart.
